rules.why: compensation equals flowCore::compensate up to f32 storage
compensate then logicle equals flowCore up to f32 storage
the manual Gating-ML strategy gives FlowKit's membership on a real sample
the gated population matches the FlowJo workspace labels
the gated population matches the FlowJo workspace labels
the gated population matches the FlowJo workspace labels
the gated population matches the FlowJo workspace labels
the gated population matches the FlowJo workspace labels

FlowJo evaluates this gate at gateResolution=256 on biex axes under a parent drawn on biex axes; the exported Gating-ML gives 487 events where the workspace counts 535, identically in cytiq and FlowKit
cytiq FlowSOM agrees with R FlowSOM about as well as R agrees with itself across seeds
cytiq and CompensAID rate the same marker channels, also on user files whose scatter carries a $PnS (Kaluza)
deGate cut-offs are density grid points; density and smooth.spline match R and every valley of this sample is populated, so the same grid point is chosen
segments come from the same events: margins, compensation, estimateLogicle and PeacoQC equal the vignette chain
CompensAID rounds the SSI to 2 decimals; round-off can move a value across a rounding boundary by one step
segment and merged event counts equal CompensAID's
PASS / merged / no-population messages equal CompensAID's
every pair gets CompensAID's verdict
RemoveMargins and PeacoQC keep the same events as the vignette chain
the margin mask flags exactly the events at the detector limit $PnR - 1
the detector limit is PeacoQC::RemoveMargins' upper threshold or above it, so RemoveMargins removes every flagged event
PeacoQC equals R PeacoQC on real compensated, transformed data
the spillover matrix equals R autospill to round-off on real single-stain controls, values above $PnR capped as flowCore::read.FCS does
the FSC/SSC gate keeps the same number of events as R autospill on every control

fluorophore spectra (rlm slopes over positives and scatter-matched negatives of the KDE-gated controls) match AutoSpectral's (lowest today: Spark NIR 685, 0.99983); AutoSpectral's own spectra move to a cosine of 0.9993 without clean.controls (r_uncleaned_cosine)
the unmixed FCS equals AutoSpectral's unmix.ols on the same spectra, up to f32 storage
with AutoSpectral's AF spectrum, cytiq's fluorophore spectra give AutoSpectral's abundances: the rest of the abundance difference is the AF spectrum

regression floor (lowest today: BV605, 0.976). The AF spectra differ: AutoSpectral takes its AF peak detector from the mean of a different gate (UV7-A against cytiq's V7-A, means within 1%) and fits 1,000 random events, between which its own AF spectrum moves to a cosine of 0.91-0.94
cytiq's ONNX Runtime reproduces the native model within cytiq-ml's export parity tolerance on real files (FlowCyt case 27 today: 2e-6, float32 inference)
a label may differ from the native argmax only where the native top two probabilities are within 1e-5 of each other
